# Reference drum rack presets (spike apricitus-fcd309)

Ground truth for the kit preset writer (M1, apricitus-109615). The analysis is in
`design/daw-presets.md`. Every file is gzipped XML. None of them contains audio; they only point
at audio paths, and those paths do not exist on this machine.

`{V}` below stands for the DAW vendor's seven-letter name. It appears in the upstream repository
names and inside the files (the XML root element and some element names). This project never writes
the name, so it is masked here.

## Saved by the DAW (from permissively licensed public repositories)

These are *provisional* evidence: they come from other people's installs, not the owner's licensed
install. Re-check them against the owner's library (see "Re-check" in the design note).

| File | What it holds | DAW version (header) | Source (commit) | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `daw-12.3-drum-sampler-kit.adg` | 16-pad drum rack, one Drum Sampler (`DrumCell`) per pad, Core Library one-shots, choke group 1 on the hats | `MinorVersion="12.0_12300"`, creator 12.3.2 | github.com/g-lok/chirashi `tests/testdata/{v}_kit/drum kit.adg` @ 538a8604842d0b74c08596831c9a4d743063b24a (2026-09-15) | MIT, (c) 2026 G |
| `daw-12.3-simpler-kit-64.adg` | 64-pad drum rack, a Simpler (`OriginalSimpler`) on 62 pads and a nested instrument rack on 2, pack samples, one return chain | `12.0_12300`, 12.3.2 | same repository, `rack kit.adg` | MIT, (c) 2026 G |
| `daw-12.3-simpler-warped.adv` | one Simpler device preset (not a rack) holding a REX loop, with warp markers and slice points | `12.0_12300`, 12.3.2 | same repository, `ABAHAMBI - Abahambi.adv` | MIT, (c) 2026 G |
| `../set/public-12.2-broom-bap.als` | a set, kept for its five drum racks. Two of them come from slicing one long WAV onto pads: every pad holds a Simpler that plays the same file between `SampleStart`/`SampleEnd` frames. Also warped audio clips with warp markers | `12.0_12203`, creator 12.2 | github.com/owenbush/{v}-inspector `packages/core/test/fixtures/Broom Bap.als` @ 2ff369a4a8d5f2bf468fc3882e1cb955633936e4 (2026-05-20) | MIT, (c) 2025 Owen Bush |

## Written by this spike, not by the DAW

These are the spike's candidates for the owner's load test (task apricitus-661b66). They were
generated by a throwaway script from `daw-12.3-simpler-kit-64.adg` (full) or from scratch (trimmed).
The output is deterministic (gzip mtime 0). They are **not** reference files until the owner has
opened them in the DAW and confirmed each pad.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `candidate-full-kit.adg` | 4 pads. Each pad is a full Simpler branch copied from the 64-pad kit, with every element kept. Return chain and sends removed |
| `candidate-trimmed-kit-v12.adg` | The same 4 pads with only the elements the design note lists as needed. Header `12.0_12300` |
| `candidate-trimmed-kit-v11.adg` | Byte for byte the same XML under an older header (`11.0_11300`, 11.3.21). Tests whether the header decides which missing elements get defaults |

The pads in all three candidates (pad n on note 35 + n, so `ReceivingNote` = 128 - note):

| Pad | Note | Audio (`audio/…` next to the preset) | Settings |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | C1 = 36 | `steady-120.wav` | untouched: one-shot, whole file |
| 2 | C#1 = 37 | `detuned.wav` | transpose +3 st, detune -20 ct |
| 3 | D1 = 38 | `steady-120.wav` | region 0.5 s to 2.5 s (frames 22050 to 110250), volume -6 dB |
| 4 | D#1 = 39 | `tempo-change.wav` | warped (Beats), markers (0.25 s, 0), (4.15 s, 6.5), (8.9 s, 16) plus the hidden last marker, classic mode, release 120 ms |

The audio is the output of the sidecar spike's deterministic generator (apricitus-2831a6,
`scripts/daw-fixture-audio.py`, 44.1 kHz mono; `DefaultDuration` matches its frame counts: 418950, 374850, 403515). Audio is never committed. `FileRef/Path` points at
`/Users/Shared/apricity-spike/presets/audio/`, `RelativePath` at `audio/<name>`
(`RelativePathType` 1). `OriginalFileSize` and `OriginalCrc` are 0 on purpose.

## Verify

```sh
cd crates/apricity-daw/tests/fixtures/reference/presets
for f in *.adg *.adv *.als; do gzip -t "$f" && gunzip -c "$f" | xmllint --noout - && echo "ok $f"; done
git ls-files | grep -E '\.(wav|aif|aiff|mp3|flac)$' || echo "no audio tracked"
```
